name: devflow-pr-mcp
description: Pull-request review assistant: PR context, risk, diffs, checklists, stand-ups and release notes. Read-only.
long_description:
DevFlow gives Claude the context a reviewer gathers by hand: PR details, the diff that matters, CI status, linked issues, a risk score that says where to look first, review checklists, your recent activity for stand-ups, and release notes between two tags. It only reads from GitHub; it never changes anything.

If you are signed in with the GitHub CLI (`gh auth login`), leave the token field empty.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Leave empty if you use the GitHub CLI (gh auth login). Otherwise paste a read-only token.

tools.name: get_pr_context
tools.description: PR details, changed files, CI status and linked issues

tools.name: analyze_pr_risk
tools.description: 0–100 risk score with reasons and which files to read first

tools.name: get_pr_diff
tools.description: The code changes for chosen files, within a size budget

tools.name: list_review_queue
tools.description: PRs waiting for your review, oldest first

tools.name: get_my_activity
tools.description: Your merged, in-progress and reviewed PRs for stand-ups

tools.name: generate_release_notes
tools.description: Release notes for PRs merged between two tags or dates
